response.interpretation_notes: Three temperature-dependent conversion curves are present in the main plot. Points follow marker centers for the black open-circle series and the visible dash/marker centers for the blue and red series; the final 60 min markers are slightly clipped by the right frame.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.
